status: fixed before sampling or latency measurement

source.selection: seed 7 fixed for controlled decoding contrasts, not best P108 test seed

contextPolicy: reject initial prompt over16; stop context_limit before forward over16; no implicit sliding window
filterOrder: temperature -> exact top-k by descending probability/ascending ID -> renormalize -> minimal top-p prefix including threshold-crossing token -> renormalize; tests cover composition although measured variants use one truncation at most
rng: LCG32: state=(1664525*state+1013904223) mod2^32; u=state/2^32; one draw per sampled token; inverse CDF in vocabulary ID order; greedy consumes no draw
specialTokens: no token suppression; EOS emitted and logged then stop; PAD/BOS/UNK remain possible if model assigns mass
controls: maxNewTokens=1 with first prompt; max_new_tokens reason if no earlier EOS
21 IDs of prompt (BOS +20 el tokens): reject by default
same long prompt with explicit left_preserve_bos window: keep BOS+last15 IDs and reset positions, diagnostic out of training context
fixed-logits fixtures for ties, exact top-p crossing, renormalization and CDF boundaries

streaming.transport: real JSONL stdout flush after each inference step; consumer sends request on stdin after ready; no artificial sleeps; no HTTP/SSE claim
streaming.clock: producer perf_counter_ns and consumer hrtime.bigint, relative durations only; never compare absolute timestamps across processes
streaming.metrics: client TTFT from stdin request write to first token line, total until done, mean inter-token gap=(last-first)/(n-1) when n>1; retain producer timings and chunk/coalescing arrivals
streaming.excluded: model imports/loading and container startup precede ready; no tokenization of arbitrary text; no GPU, KV-cache, concurrency or network benchmark

selection: all36 rollouts and controls retained; no strategy winner or best sample selection; repeated greedy seeds intentionally retained
limits: tiny 3205-parameter causal model and known synthetic grammar, not LLM quality
reusing trained weights, not fine-tuning; all model probabilities differ from filtered selection probabilities
three sampling seeds are examples, not diversity/quality population estimates
timings illustrative on this CPU/pipe; replay in blog is not live inference/streaming
no certainty that decoding filters fix grammar, facts or calibration
